Scratch files under the sandbox scratchpad only; nothing in the repo was modified.

FRESHNESS EVIDENCE IS TIME-BOXED. `git log` retains only 51 commits spanning 2026-08-03T03:07Z → 2026-08-04T06:32Z (~29 hours) — the repo begins at a squashed base commit. So "content unchanged in git" statements cover ~29 hours and ~10 refresh cycles, not months. Within that window: ktcSfTep changed 9×, dynastyDaddySf 8×, fantasyCalc 7×, draftSharksIdp 6×, draftSharksSf 5×, flockFantasySf 4×, fantasyProsSf 3×, otcffbSf 2×, dlfSf 2×; and dlfIdp / dlfRookieSf / dlfRookieIdp / idpShow / yahooBoone / fantasyProsFitzmaurice / pfkDynasty / fantasyNavigatorSf / dynastyNerdsSfTep / fantasyProsIdp / flockFantasySfRookies / idpTradeCalc changed 0 times. For the monthly vendors (Boone, Fitzmaurice) 0 changes is expected; for idpTradeCalc — the IDP backbone, on a 6h budget — I cannot distinguish "the vendor board is genuinely static" from "the scraper preserved last-good" beyond the one run I caught red-handed (2026-08-03T23:57Z). Longer-run freshness is NOT VERIFIABLE FROM THIS REPOSITORY.

EFFECTIVE INDEPENDENT SOURCE COUNT. Nominal: 21 registry sources (plus `ktc`, loaded but non-voting since 2026-04-28). By VENDOR the count collapses to 13: DLF ×4 (dlfSf, dlfIdp, dlfRookieSf, dlfRookieIdp — one expert panel, one login, one fetcher), FantasyPros ×3 (fantasyProsSf, fantasyProsIdp, fantasyProsFitzmaurice — the last is one named analyst on the same site), Flock ×2, DraftSharks ×2 (one DOM split into two CSVs, then re-merged into ONE combined rank list in Phase 1b), KTC ×2 (ktc + ktcSfTep from one scrape — I verified the two live CSVs differ on exactly 74 rows, all TEs), plus idpTradeCalc, fantasyCalc, otcffbSf, dynastyDaddySf, fantasyNavigatorSf, pfkDynasty, dynastyNerdsSfTep, yahooBoone, idpShow.

By SIGNAL the count collapses further. Correlations I measured on the raw CSVs (residual = per-source percentile minus the cross-source consensus, which strips the "everyone agrees Josh Allen is good" component):
  · idpTradeCalc ~ idpShow: residual r = +0.986 (n=188); raw Spearman 0.982-0.986; IDPTC IDP ranks 2-16 map to idpShow 1,3,4,…,16 in lock-step. These are one source.
  · ktcSfTep ~ idpTradeCalc: residual r = +0.560 (n=255); raw Spearman 0.9844 on 451 shared offense players; median value ratio 1.0038 (p10 0.919, p90 1.132). CLAUDE.md calls these "directly comparable" — they are closer to the same board, and they are the ONLY two sources on the value-direct path.
  · fantasyCalc ~ dynastyDaddySf: residual r = +0.677 (n=254). Two "crowd" boards.
  · fantasyNavigatorSf ~ ktcSfTep: raw Spearman 0.9395; the registry itself admits FN's rows carry `ktc_player_id` and credits KTC as a data source (`src/api/data_contract.py:1349-1354`).
  · pfkDynasty ~ ktcSfTep: residual r = +0.450. PFK also publishes a `pfk_ktc_values` table; `scripts/fetch_pfk.py:68-71` deliberately reads `pfk_dynasty_rankings` instead, which is the right call.
My honest estimate of effective independent OFFENSE signals: about 6-8, not 14 — one retail-market cluster (ktcSfTep / idpTradeCalc / fantasyNavigatorSf / pfkDynasty), one crowd-trade cluster (fantasyCalc / dynastyDaddySf / otcffbSf), and roughly five genuinely separate expert panels (dlfSf, dynastyNerdsSfTep, fantasyProsSf, flockFantasySf, yahooBoone/Fitzmaurice, draftSharks). For IDP: 3 at most (idpTradeCalc+idpShow as one, dlfIdp, fantasyProsIdp, draftSharksIdp) — and because of the α=0.10 anchor plus the ±15% corridor clamp, 79.9% of IDP rows end up within ±15% of idpTradeCalc alone (r = 0.9861). I deliberately did NOT report an "n_eff = n/(1+(n−1)ρ̄)" number: with residual correlations the mean ρ̄ is negative by construction (residuals sum to zero), so the formula returns nonsense. The pairwise numbers above are the honest measurement.

CONFIGURED BUT NO LONGER UPDATING. (1) FootballGuys — stamps frozen at 2026-05-24, the workflow step is a comment with no command, three code paths still reference it. (2) `data/raw_sources/` + `data/identity/` — last snapshot 2026-04-20, no producer, still served by `/api/scaffold/raw` and `/api/scaffold/identity`. (3) `data/adamidp_normalized.json` — manual PDF extraction, `extractedAt` 2026-04-07, still bounding the IDP query universe. (4) `data/raw/pff_idp/` and `data/raw/yahoo/` — retired source directories, last write 2026-04-08. (5) `scripts/convert_dlf_csv.py` and `scripts/validate_ingest.py` — no callers.

DOES A STALE SOURCE KEEP VOTING AT FULL WEIGHT? Yes, unconditionally. `_enrich_from_source_csvs` has no freshness gate; the blend has no freshness term; `weight` is 1.0 for all 21 sources; `coverage_weight` is computed but only stamped as a diagnostic, never applied. A frozen source also keeps counting toward `sourceCount`, keeps corroborating through the Hampel median, and keeps suppressing the 30% single-source haircut.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY WELL BUILT, since the report is otherwise blunt: the fetcher failure discipline is genuinely good and consistent. Every one of the 12 API/HTML fetchers checks its row floor BEFORE writing and exits non-zero rather than overwriting, so a partial vendor response preserves last-known-good (`fetch_dlf.py:528-543`, `fetch_idpshow.py:383-400`, and the same pattern in fantasycalc/otcffb/dynasty_daddy/flock×2/dynasty_nerds/fantasypros_offense). `fetch_pfk.py` and `fetch_fantasynavigator.py` add a second dynamic guard (must retain ≥75% of the last-good row count). `Dynasty Scraper.py` has floors for its own two sources (`_KTC_SITE_RAW_FLOOR` 400, `_IDPTC_SITE_RAW_FLOOR` 700) and a Sleeper last-good snapshot with its own stamp. The failure mode across the board is last-known-good, never zeros and never a silent drop — which is the right choice, and which is exactly why the freshness-stamp defect matters so much: last-known-good is only safe if you can tell it apart from fresh.

WHAT I COULD NOT VERIFY. (a) Whether idpTradeCalc licenses/derives its IDP board from The IDP Show or vice versa — the correlation is decisive that they are one signal, the direction is not determinable from the repo. (b) BDVM: `data/bdvm/` does not exist here (gitignored), so the Clay ESPN PDF, IDP Show projections and nflverse baseline are Not Verifiable from Repository. (c) Whether the missing 2h cron slots are GitHub scheduling drift or job failures — that needs the Actions run history. (d) `data/nfl_data_cache/` holds fresh nflverse pulls (weekly_stats + snap_counts 2020-2025, id_map v1, fetched 2026-08-04T09:28Z) but I did not trace their consumers in depth. (e) `src/news/providers/` (10 RSS/API providers feeding the BDVM news→events lane) and `src/ros/sources/` (5 ROS adapters) were inventoried but not audited — they are outside the named file list.

DOC-VS-CODE DISAGREEMENTS FOUND (each also filed as a finding where it has consequences): the workflow comment claiming stamps can only be written for rewritten CSVs; the pick-discount docstring asserting a 0.82 market relationship the live market contradicts; the corridor clamp justifying itself by a deleted calibration pass; the Hampel docstring's 500-point floor vs the 1000.0 constant and its phantom "MAD>0" guard; the rookie-ladder description in the registry vs the pass-through in the live branch; `_CRITICAL_PRIMARY_SOURCES` naming two sources the scraper cannot report; the `idpTradeCalc` registry entry justifying its weight by FootballGuys' anchor role; `_SOURCE_CSV_PATHS["fantasyProsIdp"]` describing a "Rank column alias handshake" when the loader reads `effectiveRank` directly; and CLAUDE.md's API table listing `/api/scaffold/raw` with no note that it serves April data.
